Apply an explicit source-to-reference lineage crosswalk

Source: R/08_external_reference.R
apply_lineage_crosswalk.Rd

Adds a harmonized lineage column using a user-supplied mapping. This avoids assuming that source-specific lineage codes are interchangeable with the descriptive lineage labels used by an external reference dataset.

Usage

apply_lineage_crosswalk(
  phenotype,
  crosswalk,
  source_lineage_col = "TCGA_lineage",
  crosswalk_source_col = "TCGA_lineage",
  crosswalk_target_col = "Celligner_lineage",
  target_col = "Celligner_lineage"
)

Arguments

phenotype

Data frame containing source lineage annotations.

crosswalk

Data frame with one row per source-to-reference mapping.

source_lineage_col

Source lineage column in `phenotype`.

crosswalk_source_col

Source lineage column in `crosswalk`.

crosswalk_target_col

Target reference lineage column in `crosswalk`.

target_col

Name of the output harmonized lineage column.

Value

`phenotype` with an additional harmonized lineage column.
